name: buddy-cli
description: Buddy.works CI/CD pipeline management through the buddy CLI: run deployments, check execution status, read logs, and troubleshoot failures.

interface.shortDescription: Run, monitor and debug Buddy.works pipelines
interface.longDescription: Drive Buddy.works CI/CD from your agent with the buddy CLI: run and follow deployments, list executions, read action logs, and diagnose failed builds.
defaultPrompt: Use $buddy-cli:status to show recent Buddy.works executions.
Use $buddy-cli:logs to read the logs of a failed execution.
Use $buddy-cli:deploy to run a Buddy.works pipeline.
